senses.gloss: क्तिच् kṛt affix ति added to roots in the benedictive sense to form संज्ञाशब्द or nouns in a technical sense; e.g- तन्तिः in the sense of तनुतात्: cf. Kāś. on III.3.174. क्त is also added in the same way. See क्त.
क्तिन् kṛt affix ति added to roots to form nouns in the sense of verb- action; e.g. कृति:, स्थितिः, मति: etc.;cf. P.III.3.94-97.
